1100281 Unbox: Enabling Rust based Cardano dApps - Milestone 1 Report 
Prepared by Unbox & MLabs on May 22, 2024 
Overview 
In this milestone, we worked on a Rust implementation of the Plutip library. 
Plutip is a tool that allows users to quickly and easily orchestrate and submit transactions against a standalone, disposable testnet. 
This library allows smart contract developers to orchestrate this flow using Rust. 
Outputs 
Outputs of the milestone can be found here: 
・Rust library for controlling (configuring, starting, stopping) Plutip local Cardano networks to use for fast and hermetic Cardano dApp testing. 
・The implementation is located within tx-bakery as a subcomponent. 

Additionally: 
・The test suite utilizing Plutip to run real smart contracts in Rust can be located at tx-bakery/extras/tx-bakery-testsuite/tests/tests/main.rs . 

Acceptance criteria and evidence 
・The library can be used to configure and start the local Cardano network using Plutip. 
・setup_plutip_test within the test suite in tx-bakery demonstrates how the library can be used to configure and start Plutip.
・The library can be used to query and stop the local Cardano network using Plutip. 
・Plutip can be queried similarly to a cardano-node using its node.socket , as demonstrated within the test suite. 
・Leveraging Rustʼs RAII, Plutip will automatically be stopped when the object goes out of scope. 
・The Plutip Rust library test suite passes.
・A passing test suite utilising Plutip can be found at tx-bakery/extras/tx-bakery-testsuite/tests/tests/main.rs .

1100281 Unbox: Enabling Rust-based Cardano dApps - Milestone 2 Report 
Prepared by Unbox & MLabs on May 22, 2024 
Overview 
In this milestone, we worked on a Rust implementation of the Plutus Ledger API as found in IntersectMBO/plutus/plutus-ledger-api.
These types are utilized in building transactions in our next milestone(s). 
Outputs 
Outputs of the milestone can be found here: 
・A Rust library with all https://github.com/IntersectMBO/plutus/tree/master/plutus-ledger-api types and functions to facilitate transaction building and parsing in Rust. 
・The implementation is located at plutus-ledger-api-rust . 

Additionally: 
・The test suite for testing equality and Plutus data encoding for these types can be found at plutus-ledger-api-rust/tests/plutus-data.rs . 

Acceptance criteria and evidence 
・The library has all types from Plutus Ledger API versions 1 and 2. 
・V1 types are located within plutus-ledger-api/src/v1 .
・V2 types are located within plutus-ledger-api/src/v2 . 
・The library has all implementations for equality and Plutus Data encoding type classes. 
・All types within V1 and V2 modules implement Eq , PartialEq , and IsPlutusData 
・Equality and Plutus Data encoding implementations are tested against a known good set of samples (golden tests). 
・Test suite can be found at plutus-ledger-api-rust/tests/plutus-data.rs .

1100281 Unbox: Enabling Rust-based Cardano dApps - Milestone 3 Report 
Prepared by Unbox & MLabs on May 22, 2024 
Overview 
In this milestone, we worked on a Rust library for building and parsing Cardano transactions centered around the concept of the TxInfo type from plutus-ledger-api .
We utilise cardano-serialization-lib alongside our plutus-ledger-api implementation in Rust (see: Milestone 2) to achieve this. 
Outputs 
Outputs of the milestone can be found here: 
・Rust library featuring an API for convenient transaction building and parsing centered around plutus-ledger-api TxInfo type. 
・The implementation is located at tx-bakery/tx-bakery . 

Additionally: 
・The test suite that builds complex TxInfo values can be located at tx-bakery/extras/tx-bakery-testsuite/tests/tests/main.rs . 

Acceptance criteria and evidence 
・A full Cardano transaction can be built given an appropriately built plutus-ledger-api TxInfo value. 
・Building a full Cardano transaction from a TxInfo and other witnesses can be done using bake and deliver and similar TxBakery methods.
・A Cardano transaction can be parsed into an equivalent plutus-ledger-api TxInfo value. 
・A Cardano transaction from cardano-serialization-lib can be converted to equivalent plutus-ledger-api types using csl_to_pla . 
・The test suite that covers complex TxInfo values. 
・A test suite demonstrating complex smart contracts can be located at tx-bakery/extras/tx-bakery-testsuite/tests/tests/main.rs .

Outputs of the milestone can be found here:

Acceptance criteria and evidence 
・Nix API to conveniently and simply specify a Rust project in a mono-repository environment, featuring a development, test and build environments. 
・The API can be located at flake-lang.nix/flake-rust.nix .
・Nix API has to enable providing both library and data dependencies from within Nix. 
・The functions that enable linking of library dependencies are located in this section. 
・The functions that enable linking of data dependencies are located in this section. 
・An example Rust project built with this Nix API must pass the CI. 
・Example rust project: https://github.com/mlabs-haskell/flake- lang.nix/tree/main/examples/rust-flake-project
